integrity.euler_basis: A generic one-parameter subgroup separates all weights; all ambient fixed weight lines lie on the closed orbit, so every secant has the same finite fixed locus and Euler localization applies.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1401.1956 lists version 1 on 2014-01-09 UTC.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The arXiv record for 1401.1956 lists MSC classes 14M15, 14M17, 14L30, with 14M15 first.
integrity.secant_basis: The same source studies the secant varieties of the closed minimal orbit in the projectivized representation.
integrity.weight_basis: The inspected source states that in a minuscule representation the weights form the Weyl orbit of the highest weight and every weight space is one-dimensional.

scientific_limitations: The theorem requires an irreducible minuscule embedding; it is not asserted for arbitrary cominuscule or homogeneous embeddings.
Euler characteristic is coarse and does not determine the finer topology or singularities of secant varieties.
The argument is short once minuscule weight theory is combined with torus localization, so an unindexed folklore observation remains possible.
title: Euler characteristic freezes across minuscule secant towers
